name: Sungbin BYUN
headline: Films about the fragile borders between people.
intro_note: A filmmaker working across fiction, identity, family, and the quiet complexities of human connection.
hero_meta: South Korea · 80 min 12 sec · A film by Sungbin BYUN
about_heading: Making films about people at the edges of belonging.
bio_paragraph_1: Sungbin BYUN studied East Asian Philosophy and Film at Sungkyunkwan University. Guided by his conviction that art should give voice to those who suffer, he makes films with deep affection for people facing hardships beyond their control.
bio_paragraph_2: His work delicately explores characters who endure pain simply by existing, bringing their stories to life across a wide range of genres and narrative styles.
